_comment: Tier C lexical profiles: data, not code. Each profile says how to blank comments and strings, how a definition, a call, an import and a region look, which words are keywords (never calls), how scopes end (brace, indent, end, none), where documentation sits (before, after, docstring) and whether a file with no definitions is a script. Regexes are Python syntax, applied per line (MULTILINE). 'languages' maps registry language ids to profiles; anything unmapped uses 'default'.
